brief:
Palestine's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates welcomed a Brics declaration calling for a two-state solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, Middle East Eye reported. The statement marks support from the bloc of Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa for a political framework long central to international peace efforts.

Details of the specific Brics language and timing of the declaration were not immediately available.
dek: Palestine welcomes Brics declaration calling for two-state solution The Palestinian ministry of foreign affairs and Palestinia expatriates have welcomed the Brics declaration calling for a two-state solution to the Palestine issue.
title: Brics declaration endorses two-state solution to Israeli-Palestinian conflict
